title: Trump Warns Iran Deal Is Not Final, U.S. Could Resume ‘Dropping Bombs.’ Oil Prices Rise.
title_zh: 特朗普警告伊朗协议尚未最终确定，美国可能会恢复“投掷炸弹”。油价上涨。
summary: Brent crude and WTI prices were gaining after President Donald Trump warned the U.S.-Iran peace deal is still subject to change.
summary_zh: 在唐纳德·特朗普总统警告美伊和平协议仍可能发生变化后，布伦特原油和西德克萨斯中质原油价格上涨。

title: Tesla Stock Is Down. An Argentina Charger Deal Won’t Help.
title_zh: 特斯拉股价下跌。阿根廷充电器交易不会有帮助。
summary: Tesla  stock is down early Wednesday. Shares of the electric-vehicle maker were down 0.3% in premarket trading at $404.66, while  futures were up 0.1% and  futures were down 0.1%.
summary_zh: 特斯拉股价周三早盘下跌。这家电动汽车制造商的股价在盘前交易中下跌 0.3%，至 404.66 美元，而期货上涨 0.1%，期货下跌 0.1%。

title: Nasdaq Futures Rising as Iran Peace Deal Boosts the Market Ahead of Fed Decision
title_zh: 伊朗和平协议在美联储决定前提振市场，纳斯达克期货上涨
summary: Stocks were on track to rise Wednesday after more details about the U.S.-Iran peace deal leaked, bolstering hopes that the two countries are on the brink of reaching an agreement to end the war in the Middle East.
summary_zh: 在美伊和平协议的更多细节泄露后，股市周三有望上涨，增强了人们对两国即将达成协议以结束中东战争的希望。

title: Apollo and Blackstone Just Closed a $35 Billion Private Credit Deal to Finance Anthropic's Compute Expansion. Here's What It Means for Micron and Nvidia.
title_zh: Apollo 和 Blackstone 刚刚完成了一项价值 350 亿美元的私人信贷交易，为 Anthropic 的计算扩展提供资金。这对美光和英伟达意味着什么。
summary: The massive deal will affect the chipmakers differently.
summary_zh: 这笔巨额交易将对芯片制造商产生不同的影响。
